opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity + note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, search Booking.com hotels, find a Viator activity, then save a summary note with prices.
steps: On Google Flights set origin/destination, pick departure and return dates, search and note cheapest flight
On Booking.com enter destination, select dates, search, open a top hotel and note price
On Viator search for a top attraction tour in the destination and open the first result, note price
Open Notes app, create a new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., activity...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: PyPI package comparison note
opportunities.description: Look up two Python packages on PyPI, collect version, release date, stars and license from the repo, and save a comparison note.
steps: Search PyPI for package A, open its page, note version/date/license
Click Source/Repository link and note star count
Create a note 'A version date stars license vs B ...'

opportunities.name: Browser feature support lookup and reply email
opportunities.description: Check caniuse for a web feature, look up MDN docs, then draft an email to a person with support info and docs link.
steps: Search the feature on caniuse and read support for the browser
Search the feature on MDN and open the docs page
Compose mail to recipient with subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>' and body with version and docs URL
